tools.name: set_hiring_runtime_gate
tools.description: Audited control for opening or closing authenticated candidate application intake. Brand owners and recruiters may operate it.
statements: UPDATE hiring_runtime_gate SET intake_status=:intake_status,reason_code=CASE WHEN :intake_status='open' THEN 'staff_authorized' ELSE 'staff_closed' END,updated_at=:__now WHERE id=1 AND :intake_status IN ('open','closed') AND length(trim(:operation_id)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id OR id=:operation_id) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND p.requisition_id IS NULL)

INSERT INTO hiring_audit_events(id,organization_id,brand_id,application_id,action,actor_user_id,operation_id,created_at,object_type,object_id,redacted_summary) SELECT :operation_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,NULL,CASE WHEN :intake_status='open' THEN 'intake.opened' ELSE 'intake.closed' END,:__user_id,:operation_id,:__now,'runtime_gate','1',CASE WHEN :intake_status='open' THEN 'Authenticated candidate intake enabled' ELSE 'Candidate intake disabled' END WHERE changes()=1

tools.description: list applications
tools.sql: SELECT a.id,a.requisition_id,COALESCE(a.accepted_stage,a.stage_extension,a.stage) AS stage,a.version,CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_intake_receipts ir WHERE ir.application_id=a.id AND ir.organization_id=a.organization_id AND ir.brand_id=a.brand_id) THEN 'direct' ELSE COALESCE((SELECT s.source FROM hiring_application_sources s WHERE s.application_id=a.id),a.source) END AS source,a.source_detail,a.basis_reference,a.contact_context,a.assignee_user_id,a.created_at,a.updated_at,c.name AS candidate_name,c.email,c.phone,COALESCE(c.linkedin_profile_url,NULLIF(c.linkedin_url,'')) AS linkedin_url,COALESCE((SELECT s.profile_url FROM hiring_application_sources s WHERE s.application_id=a.id),c.linkedin_profile_url,NULLIF(c.linkedin_url,'')) AS profile_url,r.title AS requisition_title FROM hiring_applications a JOIN hiring_candidates c ON c.id=a.candidate_id AND c.organization_id=a.organization_id AND c.brand_id=a.brand_id JOIN hiring_requisitions r ON r.id=a.requisition_id AND r.organization_id=a.organization_id AND r.brand_id=a.brand_id WHERE COALESCE(a.accepted_stage,a.stage_extension,a.stage)=:stage) AND (:requisition_id IS NULL OR a.requisition_id=:requisition_id) AND (:assignee IS NULL OR a.assignee_user_id=:assignee) AND (:source IS s.source FROM hiring_application_sources s WHERE s.application_id=a.id),a.source) END)=:source) AND (:date_from IS NULL OR a.created_at>=:date_from) AND (:date_to IS NULL OR a.created_at<:date_to) INSERT OR IGNORE INTO hiring_stage_events(id,organization_id,brand_id,application_id,from_stage,to_stage,version,reason,actor_user_id,created_at) SELECT :operation_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:application_id,NULL,'submitted',1,'LinkedIn sourced',:__user_id,:__now WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=:requisition_id)) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_applications WHERE id=:application_id AND organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id OR id=:operation_id) AND length(trim(:operation_id))>0 AND changes()=1

tools.name: change_application_stage
tools.description: Change stage using application-stages.json v1 edges, expected version, scoped owner/recruiter authority, operation deduplication and atomic history/audit
statements: INSERT INTO hiring_decisions SELECT :operation_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,a.requisition_id,a.id,:__user_id,(SELECT p.role FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=a.requisition_id) ORDER BY p.role LIMIT 1),:to_stage,:reason,:__now,a.version,COALESCE(a.accepted_stage,a.stage_extension,a.stage),:operation_id FROM hiring_applications a WHERE id=:application_id AND organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id AND version=:expected_version AND COALESCE(accepted_stage,stage_extension,stage)=:from_stage AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_applications pa WHERE pa.id=:application_id AND pa.organization_id=:organization_id AND pa.brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=pa.requisition_id))) AND ((COALESCE(accepted_stage,stage_extension,stage)='submitted' AND :to_stage IN ('in_review')) OR (COALESCE(accepted_stage,stage_extension,stage)='in_review' AND :to_stage IN ('shortlisted','rejected','interviewing')) OR (COALESCE(accepted_stage,stage_extension,stage)='shortlisted' AND :to_stage IN ('offered','rejected','interviewing')) OR (COALESCE(accepted_stage,stage_extension,stage)='offered' AND :to_stage IN ('hired','rejected')) OR (COALESCE(accepted_stage,stage_extension,stage)='interviewing' AND :to_stage IN ('decision_pending')) OR (COALESCE(accepted_stage,stage_extension,stage)='decision_pending' AND :to_stage IN ('offered','rejected'))) AND length(trim(:reason))>0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_stage_events WHERE id=:operation_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id OR id=:operation_id) AND length(trim(:operation_id))>0 AND (:to_stage NOT IN ('offered','hired') OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hiring_offers o JOIN hiring_offer_versions v ON v.offer_id=o.id AND v.version=o.current_version WHERE o.application_id=:application_id AND o.tenant_id=:organization_id AND o.brand_id=:brand_id AND o.status='approved' AND json_extract(v.terms_json,'$.compensation_type')='paid')) AND :to_stage IN ('hired','rejected')

UPDATE hiring_applications SET stage=CASE WHEN :to_stage='shortlisted' THEN 'in_review' ELSE :to_stage END,stage_extension=CASE WHEN :to_stage='shortlisted' THEN 'shortlisted' ELSE NULL END,version=version+1,updated_at=:__now WHERE id=:application_id AND organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id AND version=:expected_version AND COALESCE(accepted_stage,stage_extension,stage)=:from_stage AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_applications pa WHERE pa.id=:application_id AND pa.organization_id=:organization_id AND pa.brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=pa.requisition_id))) AND ((COALESCE(accepted_stage,stage_extension,stage)='submitted' AND :to_stage IN ('in_review')) OR (COALESCE(accepted_stage,stage_extension,stage)='in_review' AND :to_stage IN ('shortlisted','rejected','interviewing')) OR (COALESCE(accepted_stage,stage_extension,stage)='shortlisted' AND :to_stage IN ('offered','rejected','interviewing')) OR (COALESCE(accepted_stage,stage_extension,stage)='offered' AND :to_stage IN ('hired','rejected')) OR (COALESCE(accepted_stage,stage_extension,stage)='interviewing' AND :to_stage IN ('decision_pending')) OR (COALESCE(accepted_stage,stage_extension,stage)='decision_pending' AND :to_stage IN ('offered','rejected'))) AND length(trim(:reason))>0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_stage_events WHERE id=:operation_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id OR id=:operation_id) AND length(trim(:operation_id))>0 AND (:to_stage NOT IN ('offered','hired') OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hiring_offers o JOIN hiring_offer_versions v ON v.offer_id=o.id AND v.version=o.current_version WHERE o.application_id=:application_id AND o.tenant_id=:organization_id AND o.brand_id=:brand_id AND o.status='approved' AND json_extract(v.terms_json,'$.compensation_type')='paid')) AND (:to_stage NOT IN ('hired','rejected') OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hiring_decisions d WHERE d.operation_id=:operation_id AND d.actor_id=:__user_id AND d.application_id=:application_id))

INSERT OR IGNORE INTO hiring_stage_events(id,organization_id,brand_id,application_id,from_stage,to_stage,version,reason,actor_user_id,created_at) SELECT :operation_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:application_id,:from_stage,:to_stage,:expected_version+1,:reason,:__user_id,:__now FROM hiring_applications a WHERE a.id=:application_id AND a.organization_id=:organization_id AND a.brand_id=:brand_id AND a.version=:expected_version+1 AND COALESCE(a.accepted_stage,a.stage_extension,a.stage)=:to_stage AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_applications pa WHERE pa.id=:application_id AND pa.organization_id=:organization_id AND pa.brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=pa.requisition_id))) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id OR id=:operation_id) AND length(trim(:operation_id))>0 AND changes()=1

INSERT OR IGNORE INTO hiring_audit_events(id,organization_id,brand_id,application_id,action,actor_user_id,operation_id,created_at) SELECT :operation_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:application_id,'application.stage_changed',:__user_id,:operation_id,:__now WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_applications pa WHERE pa.id=:application_id AND pa.organization_id=:organization_id AND pa.brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=pa.requisition_id))) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_stage_events WHERE id=:operation_id AND application_id=:application_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id OR id=:operation_id) AND length(trim(:operation_id))>0 AND changes()=1

tools.description: Record a human-confirmed candidate email only when the scoped application has no conflicting email; creates an audit event.
statements: UPDATE hiring_candidates SET email=lower(trim(:email)) WHERE id=(SELECT a.candidate_id FROM hiring_applications a WHERE a.id=:application_id AND a.organization_id=:organization_id AND a.brand_id=:brand_id) AND organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id AND (email IS NULL OR trim(email)='' OR lower(trim(email))=lower(trim(:email))) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_applications pa WHERE pa.id=:application_id AND pa.organization_id=:organization_id AND pa.brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=pa.requisition_id))) AND length(trim(:email)) BETWEEN 3 AND 254 AND :email=trim(:email) AND :email NOT GLOB '*[ '||char(9)||char(10)||char(13)||']*' AND instr(:email,char(0))=0 AND length(:email)-length(replace(:email,'@',''))=1 AND length(substr(:email,instr(:email,'@')+1))>=3 AND instr(substr(:email,instr(:email,'@')+1),'.')>1 AND substr(:email,-1)<>'.' AND length(trim(:operation_id))>0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id OR id=:operation_id)

tools.name: record_candidate_email
tools.description: Append an immutable, full-content Gmail record after an agent receives or sends candidate email; this does not send email Optional logical_email_id requires the exact scoped send claimant; conflicting links abort. Existing unlinked archives remain immutable; zero changes requires readback, never means success.
statements: INSERT OR IGNORE INTO hiring_communication_events(id,organization_id,brand_id,application_id,direction,channel,from_email,to_email,subject,body,provider_message_id,provider_thread_id,occurred_at,actor_user_id,agent_instance_id,operation_id,created_at,logical_email_id) SELECT :communication_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:application_id,:direction,'gmail',:from_email,:to_email,:subject,:body,:provider_message_id,NULLIF(trim(:provider_thread_id),''),:occurred_at,:__user_id,:agent_instance_id,:operation_id,:__now,:logical_email_id FROM hiring_applications a JOIN hiring_candidates c ON c.id=a.candidate_id WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_applications pa WHERE pa.id=:application_id AND pa.organization_id=:organization_id AND pa.brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=pa.requisition_id))) AND a.id=:application_id AND a.organization_id=:organization_id AND a.brand_id=:brand_id AND ((:direction='inbound' AND lower(trim(:from_email))=lower(trim(c.email))) OR (:direction='outbound' AND lower(trim(:to_email))=lower(trim(c.email)))) AND :direction IN ('inbound','outbound') AND length(trim(:from_email))>0 AND length(trim(:to_email))>0 AND length(trim(:subject))>0 AND length(:subject)<=200 AND length(trim(:body))>0 AND length(:body)<=50000 AND length(trim(:provider_message_id))>0 AND length(trim(:agent_instance_id))>0 AND :occurred_at>0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id OR id=:operation_id) AND length(trim(:operation_id))>0

INSERT OR IGNORE INTO hiring_audit_events(id,organization_id,brand_id,application_id,action,actor_user_id,operation_id,created_at) SELECT :operation_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:application_id,CASE WHEN :direction='inbound' THEN 'communication.email_received' ELSE 'communication.email_sent' END,:__user_id,:operation_id,:__now WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_communication_events WHERE id=:communication_id AND organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id AND application_id=:application_id AND operation_id=:operation_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id OR id=:operation_id) AND length(trim(:operation_id))>0 AND changes()=1

tools.name: record_worker_candidate_email
tools.description: Append a full-content Cloudflare email-worker candidate email after an actual read/send; never sends mail. Keep the bridge message/thread IDs opaque and record Cloudflare receipt/event IDs separately when available. mailbox_address must equal inbound To or outbound From. Zero inserted rows means replay/conflict/refusal, never a newly archived message; verify using get_worker_candidate_email. Optional logical_email_id requires the exact scoped send claimant; conflicting links abort. Existing unlinked archives remain immutable; zero changes requires readback, never means success.
statements: INSERT OR IGNORE INTO hiring_worker_communication_events(id,organization_id,brand_id,application_id,direction,channel,provider,mailbox_address,provider_connection_id,from_email,to_email,subject,body,provider_message_id,provider_thread_id,provider_receipt_id,provider_event_id,occurred_at,actor_user_id,agent_instance_id,operation_id,created_at,logical_email_id) SELECT :communication_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:application_id,:direction,'email-worker','cloudflare',lower(trim(:mailbox_address)),COALESCE(:provider_connection_id,''),:from_email,:to_email,:subject,:body,:provider_message_id,NULLIF(:provider_thread_id,''),NULLIF(:provider_receipt_id,''),NULLIF(:provider_event_id,''),:occurred_at,:__user_id,:agent_instance_id,:operation_id,:__now,:logical_email_id FROM hiring_applications a JOIN hiring_candidates c ON c.id=a.candidate_id AND c.organization_id=a.organization_id AND c.brand_id=a.brand_id WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_applications pa WHERE pa.id=:application_id AND pa.organization_id=:organization_id AND pa.brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=pa.requisition_id))) AND a.id=:application_id AND a.organization_id=:organization_id AND a.brand_id=:brand_id AND ((:direction='inbound' AND lower(trim(:from_email))=lower(trim(c.email)) AND lower(trim(:to_email))=lower(trim(:mailbox_address))) OR (:direction='outbound' AND lower(trim(:to_email))=lower(trim(c.email)) AND lower(trim(:from_email))=lower(trim(:mailbox_address)))) AND :direction IN ('inbound','outbound') AND length(trim(:communication_id))>0 AND length(trim(:operation_id))>0 AND length(trim(:mailbox_address)) BETWEEN 3 AND 254 AND instr(:mailbox_address,'@')>1 AND length(trim(:from_email))>0 AND length(trim(:to_email))>0 AND length(trim(:subject))>0 AND length(:subject)<=200 AND length(trim(:body))>0 AND length(:body)<=50000 AND length(trim(:provider_message_id)) BETWEEN 1 AND 2000 AND length(COALESCE(:provider_connection_id,''))<=2000 AND length(COALESCE(:provider_thread_id,''))<=2000 AND length(COALESCE(:provider_receipt_id,''))<=2000 AND length(COALESCE(:provider_event_id,''))<=2000 AND length(trim(:agent_instance_id))>0 AND :occurred_at>0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id OR id=:operation_id)

INSERT OR IGNORE INTO hiring_audit_events(id,organization_id,brand_id,application_id,action,actor_user_id,operation_id,created_at) SELECT :operation_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:application_id,CASE WHEN :direction='inbound' THEN 'communication.email_received' ELSE 'communication.email_sent' END,:__user_id,:operation_id,:__now WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_worker_communication_events WHERE id=:communication_id AND organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id AND application_id=:application_id AND operation_id=:operation_id AND actor_user_id=:__user_id) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_applications pa WHERE pa.id=:application_id AND pa.organization_id=:organization_id AND pa.brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=pa.requisition_id))) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id OR id=:operation_id) AND changes()=1

AND ir.organization_id=a.organization_id AND ir.brand_id=a.brand_id) THEN 'direct' ELSE COALESCE((SELECT s.source FROM hiring_application_sources s WHERE s.application_id=a.id),a.source) END AS source,a.assignee_user_id,a.created_at,a.updated_at,c.name AS candidate_name,(c.email IS NOT NULL AND c.email<>'') AS has_email,(c.phone IS NOT NULL AND c.phone<>'') AS has_phone,(COALESCE(c.linkedin_profile_url,NULLIF(c.linkedin_url,'')) IS NOT NULL) AS has_linkedin,r.title AS requisition_title FROM hiring_applications a JOIN hiring_candidates c ON c.id=a.candidate_id AND c.organization_id=a.organization_id AND c.brand_id=a.brand_id JOIN hiring_requisitions r ON r.id=a.requisition_id AND r.organization_id=a.organization_id AND r.brand_id=a.brand_id WHERE a.organization_id=:organization_id AND a.brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND a.assignee_user_id=:__user_id)) AND (:cursor_at IS NULL OR a.updated_at < :cursor_at OR (a.updated_at = :cursor_at AND a.id > :cursor_id)) AND (:stage IS NULL OR COALESCE(a.accepted_stage,a.stage_extension,a.stage)=:stage) AND (:requisition_id IS NULL OR a.requisition_id=:requisition_id) AND (:assignee IS NULL OR a.assignee_user_id=:assignee) AND (:source IS NULL OR (CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_intake_receipts ir WHERE ir.application_id=a.id AND ir.organization_id=a.organization_id AND ir.brand_id=a.brand_id) THEN 'direct' ELSE COALESCE((SELECT s.source FROM hiring_application_sources s WHERE s.application_id=a.id),a.source) END)=:source) AND (:date_from IS NULL OR a.created_at>=:date_from) AND (:date_to IS NULL OR a.created_at<:date_to) ORDER BY a.updated_at DESC, a.id ASC LIMIT 25

tools.name: gateway_get_application
tools.description: Gateway: one redacted application for a granted brand; not-granted and missing both return no row
tools.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access g WHERE g.user_id=:__user_id AND g.organization_id=a.organization_id AND g.brand_id=a.brand_id AND g.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND (g.requisition_id IS NULL OR g.requisition_id=a.requisition_id)) THEN a.acceptance_evidence ELSE NULL END AS acceptance_evidence,a.id,a.requisition_id,COALESCE(a.accepted_stage,a.stage_extension,a.stage) AS stage,a.version,CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_intake_receipts ir WHERE ir.application_id=a.id AND ir.organization_id=a.organization_id AND ir.brand_id=a.brand_id) THEN 'direct' ELSE COALESCE((SELECT s.source FROM hiring_application_sources s WHERE s.application_id=a.id),a.source) END AS source,a.assignee_user_id,a.created_at,a.updated_at,c.name AS candidate_name,(c.email IS NOT NULL AND c.email<>'') AS has_email,(c.phone IS NOT NULL AND c.phone<>'') AS has_phone,(COALESCE(c.linkedin_profile_url,NULLIF(c.linkedin_url,'')) IS NOT NULL) AS has_linkedin,r.title AS requisition_title FROM hiring_applications a JOIN hiring_candidates c ON c.id=a.candidate_id AND c.organization_id=a.organization_id AND c.brand_id=a.brand_id JOIN hiring_requisitions r ON r.id=a.requisition_id AND r.organization_id=a.organization_id AND r.brand_id=a.brand_id WHERE a.organization_id=:organization_id AND a.brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter' ,'reviewer') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=a.requisition_id) AND (p.role<>'reviewer' OR a.assignee_user_id=:__user_id)) AND a.id=:application_id LIMIT 1

tools.name: publish_job_requisition
tools.description: Publish immutable job and notice snapshot. Brand owners and recruiters can publish approved content.
statements: INSERT INTO hiring_job_publications(requisition_id,organization_id,brand_id,description,location,arrangement,compensation,notice_version,notice_text,contact,compensation_type,actor_user_id,operation_id,created_at) SELECT :requisition_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:description,:location,:arrangement,:compensation,:notice_version,:notice_text,:contact,coalesce(:compensation_type,'unspecified'),:__user_id,:operation_id,:__now FROM hiring_requisitions r WHERE r.id=:requisition_id AND r.organization_id=:organization_id AND r.brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=NULL) AND p.requisition_id IS NULL) AND length(trim(:operation_id)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id OR id=:operation_id) AND length(trim(:description)) BETWEEN 1 AND 20000 AND length(trim(:location)) BETWEEN 1 AND 300 AND length(trim(:arrangement)) BETWEEN 1 AND 2000 AND length(trim(:compensation)) BETWEEN 1 AND 2000 AND length(trim(:notice_version)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128 AND length(trim(:notice_text)) BETWEEN 1 AND 20000 AND length(trim(:contact)) BETWEEN 1 AND 300 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_job_publications WHERE requisition_id=:requisition_id) AND coalesce(:compensation_type,'unspecified') IN ('unspecified','paid','unpaid','internship','volunteer') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_requisition_reviews v WHERE v.requisition_id=r.id AND (v.state!='pending_review' OR v.payload!=json_object('description',:description,'location',:location,'arrangement',:arrangement,'compensation',:compensation,'notice_version',:notice_version,'notice_text',:notice_text,'contact',:contact,'compensation_type',coalesce(:compensation_type,'unspecified'))))

tools.description: Public approved job/notice snapshot; no candidate or internal fields.
tools.sql: SELECT j.requisition_id,j.organization_id,j.brand_id,r.title,i.brand_name,i.organization_name,j.description,j.location,j.arrangement,j.compensation,j.compensation_type,j.notice_version,j.notice_text,j.contact,j.version FROM hiring_job_publications j JOIN hiring_publication_identities i ON i.requisition_id=j.requisition_id JOIN hiring_requisitions r ON r.id=j.requisition_id AND r.organization_id=j.organization_id AND r.brand_id=j.brand_id JOIN hiring_brands b ON b.id=j.brand_id AND b.organization_id=j.organization_id JOIN hiring_organizations o ON o.id=j.organization_id WHERE j.status='published' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_publication_controls pc WHERE pc.requisition_id=j.requisition_id AND pc.paused=1) AND o.status='active' AND j.requisition_id=:requisition_id AND ((:brand_id IS NULL AND :organization_id IS NULL) OR (j.brand_id=:brand_id AND j.organization_id=:organization_id)) LIMIT 1

tools.name: submit_job_application
tools.description: Candidate-facing intake: signed-in candidate, no recruiter membership required. Exact published scope, honeypot, validation, per-candidate rate limits, candidate/requisition deduplication and atomic consent/receipt/history/audit.
statements: INSERT INTO hiring_candidates(id,organization_id,brand_id,name,email,phone,linkedin_url,created_by,created_at,worker_user_id) SELECT :candidate_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:candidate_name,lower(trim(:email)),NULLIF(:phone,''),'',:__user_id,:__now,:__user_id WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_runtime_gate WHERE id=1 AND intake_status='open') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_worker_profiles WHERE user_id=:__user_id) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_job_publications j JOIN hiring_organizations o ON o.id=j.organization_id WHERE j.requisition_id=:requisition_id AND j.organization_id=:organization_id AND j.brand_id=:brand_id AND j.status='published' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM 1 FROM hiring_effective_access WHERE organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id AND role='owner' AND requisition_id IS NULL) AND :notice_acknowledged=1 AND :talent_pool_consent IN (0,1) AND :communications_consent IN (0,1) AND length(trim(:candidate_name)) BETWEEN 1 AND 200 AND length(trim(:email)) BETWEEN 3 AND 254 AND instr(:email,'@')>1 AND length(:phone)<=100 AND length(:statement)<=10000 AND length(trim(:application_id)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128 AND length(trim(:candidate_id)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128 AND length(trim(:idempotency_key)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128 AND length(trim(:operation_id)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id OR id=:operation_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_intake_receipts WHERE worker_user_id=:__user_id AND idempotency_key=:idempotency_key) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_candidates WHERE id=:candidate_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_applications WHERE id=:application_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_stage_events WHERE id=:operation_id) AND (SELECT count(*) FROM hiring_intake_receipts WHERE worker_user_id=:__user_id AND created_at>:__now-86400000)<10 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_intake_receipts WHERE worker_user_id=:__user_id AND created_at>:__now-10000) AND COALESCE(:website,'')='' AND :__user_id IS NOT NULL AND length(:candidate_name)<=200 AND instr(:candidate_name,char(0))=0 AND :email=trim(:email) AND :email NOT GLOB '*[ '||char(9)||char(10)||char(13)||']*' AND instr(:email,char(0))=0 AND length(:email)-length(replace(:email,'@',''))=1 AND length(substr(:email,instr(:email,'@')+1))>=3 AND instr(substr(:email,instr(:email,'@')+1),'.')>1 AND substr(:email,-1)<>'.' AND instr(:phone,char(0))=0 AND instr(:statement,char(0))=0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_intake_receipts WHERE worker_user_id=:__user_id AND organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id AND requisition_id=:requisition_id) AND length(:application_id)<=128 AND instr(:application_id,char(0))=0 AND length(:candidate_id)<=128 AND instr(:candidate_id,char(0))=0 AND length(:idempotency_key)<=128 AND instr(:idempotency_key,char(0))=0 AND length(:operation_id)<=128 AND instr(:operation_id,char(0))=0

INSERT INTO hiring_applications(id,organization_id,brand_id,requisition_id,candidate_id,source,source_detail,basis_reference,contact_context,assignee_user_id,stage,version,created_by,created_at,updated_at,submitted_snapshot_json,notice_version,idempotency_key) SELECT :application_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:requisition_id,:candidate_id,'linkedin','Direct application',:notice_version,'Candidate supplied', (SELECT user_id FROM hiring_effective_access WHERE organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id AND role='owner' AND requisition_id IS NULL ORDER BY created_at,user_id LIMIT 1),'submitted',1,:__user_id,:__now,:__now,json_object('name',:candidate_name,'email',lower(trim(:email)),'phone',:phone,'statement',:statement,'notice_version',:notice_version,'publication_version',:expected_version,'notice_acknowledged',:notice_acknowledged,'talent_pool_consent',:talent_pool_consent,'communications_consent',:communications_consent,'requisition_id',:requisition_id,'brand_id',:brand_id,'organization_id',:organization_id),:notice_version,:idempotency_key WHERE changes()=1 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_candidates WHERE id=:candidate_id AND worker_user_id=:__user_id AND organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id)

INSERT INTO hiring_intake_receipts(application_id,organization_id,brand_id,requisition_id,worker_user_id,idempotency_key,payload_json,created_at) SELECT :application_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:requisition_id,:__user_id,:idempotency_key,json_object('name',:candidate_name,'email',lower(trim(:email)),'phone',:phone,'statement',:statement,'notice_version',:notice_version,'publication_version',:expected_version,'notice_acknowledged',:notice_acknowledged,'talent_pool_consent',:talent_pool_consent,'communications_consent',:communications_consent,'requisition_id',:requisition_id,'brand_id',:brand_id,'organization_id',:organization_id),:__now WHERE changes()=1 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_applications WHERE id=:application_id AND created_by=:__user_id)

INSERT INTO hiring_consent_records(id,organization_id,brand_id,application_id,purpose,legal_basis,notice_version,evidence_reference,actor_user_id,recorded_at) SELECT :operation_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:application_id,'application_notice','contract',:notice_version,json_object('affirmative_action','application_submit','notice_text',j.notice_text,'publication_version',j.version),:__user_id,:__now FROM hiring_job_publications j WHERE j.requisition_id=:requisition_id AND changes()=1

INSERT INTO hiring_consent_records(id,organization_id,brand_id,application_id,purpose,legal_basis,notice_version,evidence_reference,actor_user_id,recorded_at) SELECT :operation_id||':'||p.purpose,:organization_id,:brand_id,:application_id,p.purpose,'consent',:notice_version,'Optional unchecked checkbox selected at submission',:__user_id,:__now FROM (SELECT 'talent_pool' AS purpose,:talent_pool_consent AS selected UNION ALL SELECT 'communications',:communications_consent) p WHERE p.selected=1 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_consent_records WHERE id=:operation_id AND actor_user_id=:__user_id AND application_id=:application_id)

INSERT INTO hiring_stage_events(id,organization_id,brand_id,application_id,from_stage,to_stage,version,reason,actor_user_id,created_at) SELECT :operation_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:application_id,NULL,'submitted',1,'Candidate submitted',:__user_id,:__now WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_consent_records WHERE id=:operation_id AND actor_user_id=:__user_id AND application_id=:application_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id)

INSERT INTO hiring_audit_events(id,organization_id,brand_id,application_id,action,actor_user_id,operation_id,created_at) SELECT :operation_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:application_id,'application.submitted',:__user_id,:operation_id,:__now WHERE changes()=1

tools.name: get_my_application_receipt
tools.description: Read original receipt for authenticated retry reconciliation; compare payload before treating replay as success.
tools.sql: SELECT r.application_id,r.organization_id,r.brand_id,r.requisition_id,r.payload_json,r.created_at,COALESCE(a.accepted_stage,a.stage_extension,a.stage) AS stage FROM hiring_intake_receipts r JOIN hiring_applications a ON a.id=r.application_id AND a.organization_id=r.organization_id AND a.brand_id=r.brand_id WHERE r.worker_user_id=:__user_id AND r.idempotency_key=:idempotency_key LIMIT 1

tools.name: list_my_job_applications
tools.description: Candidate-owned applications; excludes staff notes, contact provenance and other candidates.
tools.sql: SELECT r.application_id,r.organization_id,r.brand_id,r.requisition_id,r.created_at,COALESCE(a.accepted_stage,a.stage_extension,a.stage) AS stage,q.title,b.name AS brand_name FROM hiring_intake_receipts r JOIN hiring_applications a ON a.id=r.application_id AND a.organization_id=r.organization_id AND a.brand_id=r.brand_id JOIN hiring_requisitions q ON q.id=r.requisition_id JOIN hiring_brands b ON b.id=r.brand_id WHERE r.worker_user_id=:__user_id ORDER BY r.created_at DESC,r.application_id LIMIT 100

tools.name: create_application_attachment
tools.description: Reserve private uploader-scoped object path; pending scan, never a reviewer download authorization. Metadata is unverified until trusted scanner integration.
statements: INSERT INTO hiring_attachments(id,organization_id,brand_id,application_id,uploader_user_id,filename,storage_path,mime_type,size_bytes,checksum,operation_id,created_at) SELECT :attachment_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:application_id,:__user_id,:filename,'intake/'||:attachment_id,:mime_type,:size_bytes,:checksum,:operation_id,:__now WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_intake_receipts r WHERE r.application_id=:application_id AND r.organization_id=:organization_id AND r.brand_id=:brand_id AND r.worker_user_id=:__user_id) AND length(trim(:operation_id)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id OR id=:operation_id) AND length(:attachment_id) BETWEEN 1 AND 128 AND :attachment_id NOT GLOB '*[^a-zA-Z0-9-]*' AND length(trim(:filename)) BETWEEN 1 AND 200 AND :mime_type IN ('application/pdf','text/plain') AND :size_bytes BETWEEN 1 AND 5242880 AND length(:checksum)=64 AND :checksum NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*' AND (SELECT count(*) FROM hiring_attachments WHERE application_id=:application_id AND scan_state<>'deleted')<3 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_attachments WHERE id=:attachment_id)

INSERT INTO hiring_audit_events(id,organization_id,brand_id,application_id,action,actor_user_id,operation_id,created_at) SELECT :operation_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:application_id,'attachment.created',:__user_id,:operation_id,:__now WHERE changes()=1

tools.name: list_application_attachments
tools.description: Attachment metadata for uploader or exact assigned brand member; private paths never returned.
tools.sql: SELECT x.id,x.filename,x.mime_type,x.size_bytes,x.scan_state,x.uploader_user_id,x.created_at FROM hiring_attachments x JOIN hiring_applications a ON a.id=x.application_id AND a.organization_id=x.organization_id AND a.brand_id=x.brand_id WHERE x.organization_id=:organization_id AND x.brand_id=:brand_id AND x.application_id=:application_id AND x.scan_state<>'deleted' AND (x.uploader_user_id=:__user_id OR (a.assignee_user_id=:__user_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_applications pa WHERE pa.id=:application_id AND pa.organization_id=:organization_id AND pa.brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=pa.requisition_id))))) ORDER BY x.created_at LIMIT 3

statements: UPDATE hiring_attachments SET scan_state='deleted',deleted_at=:__now WHERE id=:attachment_id AND organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id AND application_id=:application_id AND uploader_user_id=:__user_id AND scan_state<>'deleted' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_intake_receipts r WHERE r.application_id=:application_id AND r.organization_id=:organization_id AND r.brand_id=:brand_id AND r.worker_user_id=:__user_id) AND length(trim(:operation_id)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id OR id=:operation_id)

INSERT INTO hiring_audit_events(id,organization_id,brand_id,application_id,action,actor_user_id,operation_id,created_at) SELECT :operation_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:application_id,'attachment.deleted',:__user_id,:operation_id,:__now WHERE changes()=1

tools.description: Clean attachment authorization only; no storage capability URL. Trusted scan and reviewer byte-serving integration still required.
tools.sql: SELECT x.id,x.filename,x.mime_type,x.size_bytes,x.checksum FROM hiring_attachments x JOIN hiring_applications a ON a.id=x.application_id AND a.organization_id=x.organization_id AND a.brand_id=x.brand_id WHERE x.id=:attachment_id AND x.application_id=:application_id AND x.organization_id=:organization_id AND x.brand_id=:brand_id AND x.scan_state='clean' AND (x.uploader_user_id=:__user_id OR (a.assignee_user_id=:__user_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_applications pa WHERE pa.id=:application_id AND pa.organization_id=:organization_id AND pa.brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=pa.requisition_id))))) LIMIT 1

tools.name: save_requisition_review
tools.description: Owner saves draft or submits exact job and notice for review. Version zero creates; pending review may return to draft. No legal-review gate per owner decision #52.
statements: INSERT INTO hiring_requisition_reviews(requisition_id,state,payload,actor_user_id) SELECT :requisition_id,:state,json_object('description',:description,'location',:location,'arrangement',:arrangement,'compensation',:compensation,'notice_version',:notice_version,'notice_text',:notice_text,'contact',:contact,'compensation_type',coalesce(:compensation_type,'unspecified')),:__user_id FROM hiring_requisitions r WHERE r.id=:requisition_id AND r.organization_id=:organization_id AND r.brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=NULL) AND p.requisition_id IS NULL) AND length(trim(:operation_id)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id OR id=:operation_id) AND :state IN ('draft','pending_review') AND :compensation_type IN ('paid','unpaid','internship','volunteer') AND length(trim(:description)) BETWEEN 1 AND 20000 AND length(trim(:location)) BETWEEN 1 AND 2000 AND length(trim(:arrangement)) BETWEEN 1 AND 2000 AND length(trim(:compensation)) BETWEEN 1 AND 2000 AND length(trim(:notice_version)) BETWEEN 1 AND 2000 AND length(trim(:notice_text)) BETWEEN 1 AND 20000 AND length(trim(:contact)) BETWEEN 1 AND 2000 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_job_publications WHERE requisition_id=r.id) AND :expected_version=coalesce((SELECT version FROM hiring_requisition_reviews WHERE requisition_id=r.id),0) ON CONFLICT(requisition_id) DO UPDATE SET state=excluded.state,payload=excluded.payload,actor_user_id=excluded.actor_user_id,version=version+1

INSERT INTO hiring_audit_events(id,organization_id,brand_id,action,actor_user_id,operation_id,created_at,object_type,object_id) SELECT :operation_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,'requisition.review_saved',:__user_id,:operation_id,:__now,'requisition',:requisition_id WHERE changes()=1

tools.description: Add a candidate application from any source: email, referral, LinkedIn, job board, import, manual or another source. Records contact context, assignment and audit. Does not send messages.
statements: INSERT OR IGNORE INTO hiring_candidates(id,organization_id,brand_id,name,email,phone,linkedin_url,linkedin_profile_url,created_by,created_at) SELECT :candidate_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:candidate_name,NULLIF(:email,''),NULLIF(:phone,''),'',NULL,:__user_id,:__now WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=:requisition_id)) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_requisitions WHERE id=:requisition_id AND organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id) AND length(trim(:candidate_name))>0 AND length(trim(:basis_reference))>0 AND length(trim(:contact_context))>0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:assignee_user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter','reviewer') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=:requisition_id)) AND length(trim(:source_detail))>0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id OR id=:operation_id) AND length(trim(:operation_id))>0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_applications WHERE id=:application_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_stage_events WHERE id=:operation_id) AND length(trim(:source)) BETWEEN 1 AND 100 AND (:profile_url IS NULL OR trim(:profile_url)='' OR (length(:profile_url)<=2000 AND (:profile_url LIKE 'https://%' OR :profile_url LIKE 'http://%')))

INSERT OR IGNORE INTO hiring_applications(id,organization_id,brand_id,requisition_id,candidate_id,source,source_detail,basis_reference,contact_context,assignee_user_id,stage,version,created_by,created_at,updated_at) SELECT :application_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:requisition_id,:candidate_id,'linkedin',:source_detail,:basis_reference,:contact_context,:assignee_user_id,'submitted',1,:__user_id,:__now,:__now WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=:requisition_id)) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_requisitions WHERE id=:requisition_id AND organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id) AND length(trim(:source_detail))>0 AND length(trim(:basis_reference))>0 AND length(trim(:contact_context))>0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_candidates WHERE id=:candidate_id AND organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:assignee_user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter','reviewer') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=:requisition_id)) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id OR id=:operation_id) AND length(trim(:operation_id))>0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_stage_events WHERE id=:operation_id) AND length(trim(:source)) BETWEEN 1 AND 100 AND (:profile_url IS NULL OR trim(:profile_url)='' OR (length(:profile_url)<=2000 AND (:profile_url LIKE 'https://%' OR :profile_url LIKE 'http://%')))

INSERT OR IGNORE INTO hiring_stage_events(id,organization_id,brand_id,application_id,from_stage,to_stage,version,reason,actor_user_id,created_at) SELECT :operation_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:application_id,NULL,'submitted',1,'Candidate added from '||trim(:source),:__user_id,:__now WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=:requisition_id)) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_applications WHERE id=:application_id AND organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id OR id=:operation_id) AND length(trim(:operation_id))>0 AND changes()=1

INSERT INTO hiring_application_sources(application_id,source,profile_url) SELECT :application_id,trim(:source),NULLIF(trim(:profile_url),'') WHERE changes()=1 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_stage_events WHERE id=:operation_id AND application_id=:application_id AND actor_user_id=:__user_id)

INSERT OR IGNORE INTO hiring_audit_events(id,organization_id,brand_id,application_id,action,actor_user_id,operation_id,created_at) SELECT :operation_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:application_id,'application.created',:__user_id,:operation_id,:__now WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=:requisition_id)) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_stage_events WHERE id=:operation_id AND application_id=:application_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id OR id=:operation_id) AND length(trim(:operation_id))>0 AND changes()=1

source.description: Where this candidate came from, e.g. email, referral, linkedin, job_board, recruiter_import, manual or another source.

tools.name: get_my_requisition_receipt

tools.sql: SELECT r.application_id,r.organization_id,r.brand_id,r.requisition_id,r.payload_json,r.created_at,COALESCE(a.accepted_stage,a.stage_extension,a.stage) AS stage FROM hiring_intake_receipts r JOIN hiring_applications a ON a.id=r.application_id AND a.organization_id=r.organization_id AND a.brand_id=r.brand_id WHERE r.worker_user_id=:__user_id AND r.organization_id=:organization_id AND r.brand_id=:brand_id AND r.requisition_id=:requisition_id LIMIT 1

tools.name: list_email_status_history
tools.description: Chronological email evidence, 50 per page. Continue with last timestamp/id until empty; no inferred legacy events.
tools.sql: SELECT e.* FROM email_status_events e JOIN hiring_outbox o ON o.logical_email_id=e.logical_email_id WHERE e.logical_email_id=:logical_email_id AND o.organization_id=:organization_id AND o.brand_id=:brand_id AND o.application_id=:application_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_applications pa WHERE pa.id=:application_id AND pa.organization_id=:organization_id AND pa.brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=pa.requisition_id))) AND (:cursor_at IS NULL OR e.timestamp>:cursor_at OR (e.timestamp=:cursor_at AND e.sequence>COALESCE((SELECT sequence FROM email_status_events WHERE id=:cursor_id AND logical_email_id=:logical_email_id),0))) ORDER BY e.timestamp,e.sequence LIMIT 50

tools.name: save_pd_draft
tools.description: Append a scoped structured PD version before publication. Editing resets pending publication review to draft; owner must review again. Expected version and operation ID prevent lost updates and duplicate writes.
statements: INSERT INTO hiring_pd_versions(requisition_id,version,payload,actor_user_id,updated_at,operation_id) SELECT r.id,:expected_version+1,json_object('overview',:overview,'rolePurpose',:rolePurpose,'responsibilities',json(:responsibilities),'requirements',json(:requirements),'workingArrangement',:workingArrangement,'compensation',:compensation,'benefits',:benefits,'applicationProcess',:applicationProcess,'privacyContact',:privacyContact),:__user_id,:__now,:operation_id FROM hiring_requisitions r WHERE r.id=:requisition_id AND r.organization_id=:organization_id AND r.brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=r.organization_id AND p.brand_id=r.brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=r.id)) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_job_publications WHERE requisition_id=r.id) AND :expected_version=coalesce((SELECT max(version) FROM hiring_pd_versions WHERE requisition_id=r.id),0) AND length(trim(:operation_id)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id OR id=:operation_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_pd_versions WHERE operation_id=:operation_id) AND length(:overview)<=20000 AND length(:rolePurpose)<=20000 AND CASE WHEN json_valid(:responsibilities) THEN json_type(:responsibilities)='array' AND json_array_length(:responsibilities)<=100 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(:responsibilities) WHERE type<>'text' OR length(value)>2000) ELSE 0 END AND CASE WHEN json_valid(:requirements) THEN json_type(:requirements)='array' AND json_array_length(:requirements)<=100 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(:requirements) WHERE type<>'text' OR length(value)>2000) ELSE 0 END AND length(:workingArrangement)<=20000 AND length(:compensation)<=20000 AND length(:benefits)<=20000 AND length(:applicationProcess)<=20000 AND length(:privacyContact)<=20000

INSERT INTO hiring_audit_events(id,organization_id,brand_id,action,actor_user_id,operation_id,created_at,object_type,object_id) SELECT :operation_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,'requisition.pd_saved',:__user_id,:operation_id,:__now,'requisition',:requisition_id WHERE changes()=1

tools.name: list_vacancies
tools.description: Public approved vacancy and immutable structured PD snapshot only. Missing or unavailable detail returns no rows (NOT_FOUND).
tools.sql: SELECT j.requisition_id,j.organization_id,j.brand_id,r.title,i.brand_name,i.organization_name,j.location,j.created_at,j.arrangement,j.description,j.compensation,pd.payload AS pd_json,pd.pd_version,'published' AS status FROM hiring_job_publications j LEFT JOIN hiring_pd_publications pd ON pd.requisition_id=j.requisition_id JOIN hiring_publication_identities i ON i.requisition_id=j.requisition_id JOIN hiring_requisitions r ON r.id=j.requisition_id AND r.organization_id=j.organization_id AND r.brand_id=j.brand_id JOIN hiring_brands b ON b.id=j.brand_id AND b.organization_id=j.organization_id JOIN hiring_organizations o ON o.id=j.organization_id WHERE j.status='published' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_publication_controls pc WHERE pc.requisition_id=j.requisition_id AND pc.paused=1) AND o.status='active' AND (:organization_id IS NULL OR :organization_id='' OR j.organization_id=:organization_id) AND (:brand_id IS NULL OR :brand_id='' OR j.brand_id=:brand_id) AND (:after_id='' OR j.requisition_id>:after_id) ORDER BY j.requisition_id LIMIT 25

tools.description: Public approved vacancy and immutable structured PD snapshot only. Missing or unavailable detail returns no rows (NOT_FOUND).

tools.name: list_vacancy_management
tools.description: Recent 100 scoped requisitions with derived review/publication lifecycle and latest activity time; no candidates.
tools.sql: SELECT r.id,r.title,CASE WHEN j.status='closed' THEN 'closed' WHEN pc.paused=1 THEN 'paused' WHEN j.status='published' THEN 'published' WHEN v.state='pending_review' THEN 'in review' ELSE 'draft' END AS state, max(r.created_at,coalesce(j.created_at,0),coalesce(d.updated_at,0),coalesce((SELECT max(a.created_at) FROM hiring_audit_events a WHERE a.organization_id=r.organization_id AND a.brand_id=r.brand_id AND a.object_id=r.id),0)) AS updated_at FROM hiring_requisitions r LEFT JOIN hiring_job_publications j ON j.requisition_id=r.id LEFT JOIN hiring_publication_controls pc ON pc.requisition_id=r.id LEFT JOIN hiring_requisition_reviews v ON v.requisition_id=r.id LEFT JOIN hiring_pd_versions d ON d.requisition_id=r.id AND d.version=(SELECT max(version) FROM hiring_pd_versions WHERE requisition_id=r.id) WHERE r.organization_id=:organization_id AND r.brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=r.organization_id AND p.brand_id=r.brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=r.id)) ORDER BY updated_at DESC,r.id LIMIT 100

tools.name: get_vacancy_management
tools.description: Read one exact scoped requisition lifecycle for an authorized owner or recruiter. Missing and denied IDs both return no rows.
tools.sql: SELECT r.id,r.title,r.status,EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access publisher WHERE publisher.organization_id=r.organization_id AND publisher.brand_id=r.brand_id AND publisher.user_id=:__user_id AND publisher.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND publisher.requisition_id IS NULL) AS can_publish,v.state AS review_state,j.version AS publication_version,j.description AS published_description,j.location AS published_location,j.arrangement AS published_arrangement,j.compensation AS published_compensation,j.contact AS published_contact,j.notice_version AS published_notice_version,j.notice_text AS published_notice_text,CASE WHEN j.status='closed' THEN 'closed' WHEN pc.paused=1 THEN 'paused' WHEN j.status='published' THEN 'published' WHEN v.state='pending_review' THEN 'in review' ELSE 'draft' END AS state, max(r.created_at,coalesce(j.created_at,0),coalesce(d.updated_at,0),coalesce((SELECT max(a.created_at) FROM hiring_audit_events a WHERE a.organization_id=r.organization_id AND a.brand_id=r.brand_id AND a.object_id=r.id),0)) AS updated_at FROM hiring_requisitions r LEFT JOIN hiring_job_publications j ON j.requisition_id=r.id LEFT JOIN hiring_publication_controls pc ON pc.requisition_id=r.id LEFT JOIN hiring_requisition_reviews v ON v.requisition_id=r.id LEFT JOIN hiring_pd_versions d ON d.requisition_id=r.id AND d.version=(SELECT max(version) FROM hiring_pd_versions WHERE requisition_id=r.id) WHERE r.organization_id=:organization_id AND r.brand_id=:brand_id AND r.id=:requisition_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=r.organization_id AND p.brand_id=r.brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=r.id)) LIMIT 1

tools.name: list_communication_templates
tools.description: List brand templates for brand-wide owners and recruiters; templates never authorize sending
tools.sql: SELECT id,name,subject,body,version,updated_at FROM hiring_communication_templates WHERE organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND p.requisition_id IS NULL) ORDER BY updated_at DESC,id LIMIT 100

tools.name: save_communication_template
tools.description: Create or edit a scoped unsent template with optimistic concurrency and audit evidence
statements: INSERT INTO hiring_communication_templates(id,organization_id,brand_id,name,subject,body,version,updated_at,operation_id) SELECT :template_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:name,:subject,:body,1,:__now,:operation_id WHERE :expected_version=0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND p.requisition_id IS NULL) AND length(trim(:name)) BETWEEN 1 AND 200 AND length(trim(:subject)) BETWEEN 1 AND 500 AND length(trim(:body)) BETWEEN 1 AND 20000 AND length(trim(:operation_id)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id OR id=:operation_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_communication_templates WHERE id=:template_id)

UPDATE hiring_communication_templates SET name=:name,subject=:subject,body=:body,version=version+1,updated_at=:__now,operation_id=:operation_id WHERE id=:template_id AND organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id AND version=:expected_version AND :expected_version>0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND p.requisition_id IS NULL) AND length(trim(:name)) BETWEEN 1 AND 200 AND length(trim(:subject)) BETWEEN 1 AND 500 AND length(trim(:body)) BETWEEN 1 AND 20000 AND length(trim(:operation_id)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id OR id=:operation_id)

INSERT INTO hiring_audit_events(id,organization_id,brand_id,application_id,action,actor_user_id,operation_id,created_at) SELECT :operation_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,NULL,'communication.template_saved',:__user_id,:operation_id,:__now WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_communication_templates WHERE id=:template_id AND organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id AND operation_id=:operation_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id OR id=:operation_id)

tools.name: list_operational_diagnostics
tools.description: Read authorized redacted activity metadata, excluding all candidate content, URLs and summaries; no result evidence means unknown
tools.sql: SELECT x.id,x.agent_instance_id,x.activity_type AS action,x.occurred_at,'unknown' AS outcome FROM hiring_agent_activity x JOIN hiring_applications a ON a.id=x.application_id AND a.organization_id=x.organization_id AND a.brand_id=x.brand_id WHERE x.organization_id=:organization_id AND x.brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=x.organization_id AND p.brand_id=x.brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter','auditor') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=a.requisition_id)) ORDER BY x.occurred_at DESC,x.id LIMIT 100

tools.name: get_org_recruiting_playbook
tools.description: Read contract schema_version=1: latest versioned organisation recruiting playbook for authenticated owners/recruiters (agents need recruiter grants). All readers receive recursive secret_* / meeting_password redaction. Version 0 means unconfigured; no rows means unavailable/denied. Stop policy-dependent activity on either fallback. See docs/agent-playbook-contract.md.
tools.sql: WITH RECURSIVE latest AS (SELECT version,payload,updated_at,actor_user_id FROM hiring_org_playbooks WHERE organization_id=:organization_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND p.requisition_id IS NULL) ORDER BY version DESC LIMIT 1), secrets AS (SELECT fullkey,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY length(fullkey) DESC,fullkey) AS n FROM latest,json_tree(latest.payload) WHERE typeof(key)='text' AND (substr(lower(key),1,7)='secret_' OR lower(key)='meeting_password')), redacted(n,payload) AS (SELECT 0,payload FROM latest UNION ALL SELECT s.n,json_remove(r.payload,s.fullkey) FROM redacted r JOIN secrets s ON s.n=r.n+1) SELECT 1 AS schema_version,l.version,r.payload,l.updated_at,l.actor_user_id,NULL AS message FROM latest l JOIN redacted r ON r.n=(SELECT count(*) FROM secrets) UNION ALL SELECT 1,0,NULL,NULL,NULL,'No playbook configured' WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND p.requisition_id IS NULL) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM latest)

tools.name: save_org_recruiting_playbook
tools.description: Organisation owner creates an immutable playbook version with optimistic concurrency and atomic organisation audit evidence. Read the saved version with get_org_recruiting_playbook.
statements: INSERT INTO hiring_org_playbooks(organization_id,version,payload,actor_user_id,updated_at,operation_id) SELECT :organization_id,:expected_version+1,:payload,:__user_id,:__now,:operation_id WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p JOIN hiring_organizations o ON o.id=p.organization_id WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role='owner' AND p.requisition_id IS NULL AND o.created_by=:__user_id) AND typeof(:expected_version) IN ('integer','real') AND :expected_version=CAST(:expected_version AS INTEGER) AND :expected_version>=0 AND length(trim(:operation_id)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128

tools.name: get_application
tools.description: Full scoped owner/recruiter application detail by ID, independent of queue limits. Missing and unauthorized IDs return no rows.
tools.sql: SELECT a.acceptance_evidence,a.id,a.requisition_id,COALESCE(a.accepted_stage,a.stage_extension,a.stage) AS stage,a.version,CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_intake_receipts ir WHERE ir.application_id=a.id AND ir.organization_id=a.organization_id AND ir.brand_id=a.brand_id) THEN 'direct' ELSE COALESCE((SELECT s.source FROM hiring_application_sources s WHERE s.application_id=a.id),a.source) END AS source,a.source_detail,a.basis_reference,a.contact_context,a.assignee_user_id,a.created_at,a.updated_at,c.name AS candidate_name,c.email,c.phone,COALESCE(c.linkedin_profile_url,NULLIF(c.linkedin_url,'')) AS linkedin_url,COALESCE((SELECT s.profile_url FROM hiring_application_sources s WHERE s.application_id=a.id),c.linkedin_profile_url,NULLIF(c.linkedin_url,'')) AS profile_url,r.title AS requisition_title FROM hiring_applications a JOIN hiring_candidates c ON c.id=a.candidate_id AND c.organization_id=a.organization_id AND c.brand_id=a.brand_id JOIN hiring_requisitions r ON r.id=a.requisition_id AND r.organization_id=a.organization_id AND r.brand_id=a.brand_id WHERE a.organization_id=:organization_id AND a.brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=a.requisition_id)) AND a.id=:application_id LIMIT 1

(p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=a.requisition_id)) THEN json_object('candidate_name',c.name,'requisition_title',r.title,'stage',COALESCE(a.accepted_stage,a.stage_extension,a.stage),'scheduled_at',i.scheduled_at,'duration_minutes',i.duration_minutes,'location',i.location,'format',i.format,'status',i.status,'email',c.email,'phone',c.phone,'profile_url',COALESCE((SELECT profile_url FROM hiring_application_sources WHERE application_id=a.id),c.linkedin_profile_url,NULLIF(c.linkedin_url,'')),'source',CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hiring_intake_receipts ir WHERE ir.application_id=a.id AND ir.organization_id=a.organization_id AND ir.brand_id=a.brand_id) THEN 'direct' ELSE COALESCE((SELECT source FROM hiring_application_sources WHERE application_id=a.id),a.source) END,'source_detail',a.source_detail,'basis_reference',a.basis_reference,'contact_context',a.contact_context,'notes',json((SELECT json_group_array(json_object('body',body,'actor_user_id',actor_user_id,'created_at',created_at)) FROM hiring_notes WHERE application_id=a.id AND organization_id=a.organization_id AND brand_id=a.brand_id)),'attachments',json((SELECT json_group_array(json_object('id',id,'filename',filename,'mime_type',mime_type,'size_bytes',size_bytes,'scan_state',scan_state)) FROM hiring_attachments WHERE application_id=a.id AND organization_id=a.organization_id AND brand_id=a.brand_id AND deleted_at IS NULL)),'worker_communications',json((SELECT json_group_array(json_object('subject',subject,'body',body,'direction',direction)) FROM hiring_worker_communication_events WHERE application_id=a.id AND organization_id=a.organization_id AND brand_id=a.brand_id)),'communications',json((SELECT json_group_array(json_object('subject',subject,'body',body,'direction',direction)) FROM hiring_communication_events WHERE application_id=a.id AND organization_id=a.organization_id AND brand_id=a.brand_id)),'drafts',json((SELECT json_group_array(json_object('subject',subject,'body',body)) FROM hiring_outbox WHERE application_id=a.id AND organization_id=a.organization_id AND brand_id=a.brand_id))) ELSE json_object('candidate_name',c.name,'requisition_title',r.title,'stage',COALESCE(a.accepted_stage,a.stage_extension,a.stage),'scheduled_at',i.scheduled_at,'duration_minutes',i.duration_minutes,'location',i.location,'format',i.format,'status',i.status) END AS packet_json FROM interviews i JOIN hiring_applications a ON a.id=i.application_id AND a.organization_id=i.tenant_id AND a.brand_id=i.brand_id AND a.requisition_id=i.requisition_id JOIN hiring_candidates c ON c.id=a.candidate_id AND c.organization_id=a.organization_id AND c.brand_id=a.brand_id JOIN hiring_requisitions r ON r.id=a.requisition_id AND r.organization_id=a.organization_id AND r.brand_id=a.brand_id WHERE i.id=:interview_id AND i.application_id=:application_id AND i.tenant_id=:tenant_id AND i.brand_id=:brand_id AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:tenant_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=a.requisition_id)) OR (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p JOIN interview_assignments ia ON ia.interview_id=i.id AND ia.reviewer_id=p.user_id AND ia.revoked_at IS NULL WHERE p.organization_id=i.tenant_id AND p.brand_id=i.brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role='reviewer' AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=i.requisition_id)) AND i.status='scheduled')) LIMIT 1

statements: INSERT INTO hiring_decisions SELECT :operation_id,:tenant_id,:brand_id,a.requisition_id,a.id,:__user_id,(SELECT p.role FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:tenant_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=a.requisition_id) ORDER BY p.role LIMIT 1),:disposition,COALESCE(:rationale,''),:__now,a.version,COALESCE(a.accepted_stage,a.stage_extension,a.stage),:operation_id FROM hiring_applications a WHERE a.id=:application_id AND a.organization_id=:tenant_id AND a.brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:tenant_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=a.requisition_id)) AND :__user_id NOT IN ('system','automation','api_key','system'||char(58)||'worker') AND a.requisition_id=:requisition_id AND a.version=:expected_version AND (:actor_id IS NULL OR :actor_id=:__user_id) AND (:actor_role IS NULL OR :actor_role=(SELECT p.role FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:tenant_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=a.requisition_id) ORDER BY p.role LIMIT 1)) AND length(trim(:operation_id))>0 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE id=:operation_id OR operation_id=:operation_id)

tools.sql: INSERT INTO erasure_requests(id,organization_id,brand_id,application_id,candidate_id,operation_id,actor_user_id,identity_verified,holds_reviewed,created_at) SELECT :__uuid,:organization_id,:brand_id,:application_id,a.candidate_id,:operation_id,:__user_id,:identity_verified,:holds_reviewed,:__now FROM hiring_applications a WHERE a.id=:application_id AND a.organization_id=:organization_id AND a.brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role='owner' AND p.requisition_id IS NULL) AND :identity_verified=1 AND :holds_reviewed=1 AND length(trim(:operation_id)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM erasure_requests r WHERE r.organization_id=a.organization_id AND r.brand_id=a.brand_id AND r.candidate_id=a.candidate_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id OR id=:operation_id)
