tools.name: record_candidate_erasure_hold
tools.description: Brand owner appends a candidate hold/release with reason reference and review date; dates never automatically release a hold. Candidate scope derives from the application. Cannot change after redaction.
statements: INSERT INTO erasure_hold_events(operation_id,organization_id,brand_id,candidate_id,state,reason_reference,review_at,actor_user_id,created_at) SELECT :operation_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,a.candidate_id,:state,:reason_reference,:review_at,:__user_id,:__now FROM hiring_applications a WHERE a.id=:application_id AND a.organization_id=:organization_id AND a.brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role='owner' AND p.requisition_id IS NULL) AND :state IN ('active','released') AND :review_at>0 AND length(trim(:reason_reference)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128 AND length(trim(:operation_id)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id OR id=:operation_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM erasure_hold_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id)

INSERT INTO hiring_audit_events(id,organization_id,brand_id,application_id,action,actor_user_id,operation_id,created_at) SELECT :operation_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:application_id,'erasure.hold_recorded',:__user_id,:operation_id,:__now WHERE changes()=1

tools.name: get_candidate_erasure_hold
tools.description: Brand owner reads current hold metadata only; no candidate contact data. Review dates do not expire holds.
tools.sql: SELECT h.state,h.reason_reference,h.review_at,h.actor_user_id,h.created_at FROM erasure_hold_events h JOIN hiring_applications a ON a.candidate_id=h.candidate_id AND a.organization_id=h.organization_id AND a.brand_id=h.brand_id WHERE a.id=:application_id AND h.organization_id=:organization_id AND h.brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role='owner' AND p.requisition_id IS NULL) ORDER BY h.sequence DESC LIMIT 1

tools.name: record_acceptance
tools.description: Record explicit candidate acceptance of approved paid offer terms; human passkey required. Read back with get_acceptance_result.
statements: INSERT INTO hiring_acceptances SELECT :operation_id,a.organization_id,a.brand_id,a.id,o.id,o.current_version,:__user_id,a.version,:acceptance_evidence,:__now FROM hiring_applications a JOIN hiring_offers o ON o.application_id=a.id AND o.tenant_id=a.organization_id AND o.brand_id=a.brand_id JOIN hiring_offer_versions v ON v.offer_id=o.id AND v.version=o.current_version WHERE a.id=:application_id AND a.organization_id=:tenant_id AND a.brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access g WHERE g.user_id=:__user_id AND g.organization_id=a.organization_id AND g.brand_id=a.brand_id AND g.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND (g.requisition_id IS NULL OR g.requisition_id=a.requisition_id)) AND :__user_id NOT IN ('system','automation','api_key','system'||char(58)||'worker') AND a.version=:expected_version AND COALESCE(a.accepted_stage,a.stage_extension,a.stage)='offered' AND o.status='approved' AND json_extract(v.terms_json,'$.compensation_type')='paid' AND length(trim(:acceptance_evidence)) BETWEEN 1 AND 10000 AND length(trim(:operation_id))>0 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hiring_acceptances WHERE operation_id=:operation_id) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE id=:operation_id OR operation_id=:operation_id) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hiring_stage_events WHERE id=:operation_id)

tools.name: get_acceptance_result
tools.description: Scoped exact acceptance retry readback; current application and committed operation.
tools.sql: SELECT a.id,a.version,COALESCE(a.accepted_stage,a.stage_extension,a.stage) AS stage,a.acceptance_evidence,x.operation_id FROM hiring_applications a JOIN hiring_acceptances x ON x.application_id=a.id WHERE a.id=:application_id AND a.organization_id=:tenant_id AND a.brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access g WHERE g.user_id=:__user_id AND g.organization_id=a.organization_id AND g.brand_id=a.brand_id AND g.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND (g.requisition_id IS NULL OR g.requisition_id=a.requisition_id)) AND :__user_id NOT IN ('system','automation','api_key','system'||char(58)||'worker') AND x.operation_id=:operation_id AND x.actor_user_id=:__user_id AND x.expected_version=:expected_version AND x.acceptance_evidence=:acceptance_evidence

tools.name: reconcile_communication
tools.description: Human evidence-backed resolution of failed/unknown sends. Not accepted creates one unsent replacement; never sends or queues. Original evidence remains immutable. Offer attempts are reconciled without replacement because existing immutable offer authorization permits only one draft.
statements: INSERT INTO hiring_outbox(id,organization_id,brand_id,application_id,recipient_email,subject,body,status,actor_user_id,created_at,operation_id,logical_email_id) SELECT :__uuid,o.organization_id,o.brand_id,o.application_id,o.recipient_email,o.subject,o.body,'draft',:__user_id,:__now,:operation_id,:__uuid FROM hiring_outbox o WHERE o.id=:draft_id AND o.organization_id=:organization_id AND o.brand_id=:brand_id AND o.application_id=:application_id AND o.delivery_state IN ('failed','unknown') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_applications pa WHERE pa.id=:application_id AND pa.organization_id=:organization_id AND pa.brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=pa.requisition_id))) AND :outcome IN ('accepted','not_accepted') AND length(trim(:evidence)) BETWEEN 1 AND 2000 AND length(trim(:operation_id))>0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id OR id=:operation_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_mail_reconciliations r WHERE r.original_draft_id=o.id) AND (:outcome='accepted' OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM email_status_events e WHERE e.logical_email_id=o.logical_email_id AND e.status IN ('accepted','sent'))) AND :outcome='not_accepted' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_offers f WHERE f.application_id=o.application_id)

INSERT INTO hiring_mail_reconciliations(id,original_draft_id,replacement_draft_id,outcome,evidence,actor_user_id,created_at) SELECT :operation_id,o.id,CASE WHEN :outcome='not_accepted' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_offers f WHERE f.application_id=o.application_id) THEN :__uuid END,:outcome,:evidence,:__user_id,:__now FROM hiring_outbox o WHERE o.id=:draft_id AND o.organization_id=:organization_id AND o.brand_id=:brand_id AND o.application_id=:application_id AND o.delivery_state IN ('failed','unknown') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_applications pa WHERE pa.id=:application_id AND pa.organization_id=:organization_id AND pa.brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=pa.requisition_id))) AND :outcome IN ('accepted','not_accepted') AND length(trim(:evidence)) BETWEEN 1 AND 2000 AND length(trim(:operation_id))>0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id OR id=:operation_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_mail_reconciliations r WHERE r.original_draft_id=o.id) AND (:outcome='accepted' OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM email_status_events e WHERE e.logical_email_id=o.logical_email_id AND e.status IN ('accepted','sent')))

INSERT INTO hiring_audit_events(id,organization_id,brand_id,application_id,action,actor_user_id,operation_id,created_at,request_id,object_type,object_id,redacted_summary) SELECT :operation_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:application_id,'outbox.reconciled',:__user_id,:operation_id,:__now,:operation_id,'outbox',:draft_id,'outbox.reconciled' WHERE changes()=1

INSERT INTO email_status_events(id,logical_email_id,status,timestamp,actor,attempt_number,metadata_json) SELECT :operation_id || '-reconciled',o.logical_email_id,CASE WHEN :outcome='accepted' THEN 'accepted' ELSE 'failed' END,:__now,:__user_id,o.attempt_count,'{"evidence":"human_reconciliation"}' FROM hiring_outbox o JOIN hiring_mail_reconciliations r ON r.original_draft_id=o.id WHERE r.id=:operation_id AND changes()=1 AND o.logical_email_id IS NOT NULL

tools.name: get_communication_reconciliation
tools.description: Scoped readback of human mail recovery evidence; never returns claim credentials.
tools.sql: SELECT r.id AS operation_id,r.outcome,r.evidence,r.actor_user_id,r.created_at,r.replacement_draft_id FROM hiring_mail_reconciliations r JOIN hiring_outbox o ON o.id=r.original_draft_id WHERE o.id=:draft_id AND o.organization_id=:organization_id AND o.brand_id=:brand_id AND o.application_id=:application_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_applications pa WHERE pa.id=:application_id AND pa.organization_id=:organization_id AND pa.brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=pa.requisition_id))) AND (:operation_id IS NULL OR (r.id=:operation_id AND r.actor_user_id=:__user_id AND r.outcome=:outcome AND r.evidence=:evidence))

tools.name: reclaim_stale_communication
tools.description: Operator recovery of a stale sending attempt to unknown only; preserves the claim and never authorizes resend. Default staleness 15 minutes, configurable in milliseconds. Compare expected_last_attempt_at from scoped draft reads. Zero changes is not confirmation.
statements: UPDATE hiring_outbox SET delivery_state='unknown' WHERE id=:draft_id AND organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id AND application_id=:application_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_applications pa WHERE pa.id=:application_id AND pa.organization_id=:organization_id AND pa.brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=pa.requisition_id))) AND length(trim(:operation_id))>0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id OR id=:operation_id) AND delivery_state='sending' AND last_attempt_at=:expected_last_attempt_at AND typeof(:expected_last_attempt_at) IN ('integer','real') AND :expected_last_attempt_at=CAST(:expected_last_attempt_at AS INTEGER) AND typeof(COALESCE(:stale_after_ms,900000)) IN ('integer','real') AND COALESCE(:stale_after_ms,900000)=CAST(COALESCE(:stale_after_ms,900000) AS INTEGER) AND COALESCE(:stale_after_ms,900000) BETWEEN 1 AND 2147483647 AND last_attempt_at<=:__now-COALESCE(:stale_after_ms,900000)

INSERT INTO hiring_audit_events(id,organization_id,brand_id,application_id,action,actor_user_id,operation_id,created_at,request_id,object_type,object_id,redacted_summary) SELECT :operation_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:application_id,'outbox.completed',:__user_id,:operation_id,:__now,:operation_id,'outbox',:draft_id,'outbox.stale_reclaimed' WHERE changes()=1 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_applications pa WHERE pa.id=:application_id AND pa.organization_id=:organization_id AND pa.brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=pa.requisition_id)))

tools.name: record_candidate_rights_event
tools.description: Owner-only versioned rights receipt, identity review, processing or decision. Opaque references only; no identity documents. Deletion/correction/withdrawal cannot be marked fulfilled by this action.
tools.sql: INSERT INTO hiring_rights_events(id,organization_id,brand_id,application_id,request_id,request_type,version,status,owner_user_id,deadline_at,proof_reference,decision_reference,actor_user_id,created_at) SELECT :operation_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:application_id,:request_id,:request_type,:expected_version+1,:status,:owner_user_id,:deadline_at,:proof_reference,:decision_reference,:__user_id,:__now FROM hiring_applications a WHERE a.id=:application_id AND a.organization_id=:organization_id AND a.brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role='owner' AND p.requisition_id IS NULL) AND length(trim(:request_id)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128 AND length(trim(:operation_id)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128 AND length(trim(:owner_user_id)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128 AND :deadline_at>0 AND :deadline_at=CAST(:deadline_at AS INTEGER) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:owner_user_id AND p.role='owner' AND p.requisition_id IS NULL) AND :request_type IN ('access','correction','withdrawal','deletion','export','objection') AND :status IN ('received','identity_verification','processing','fulfilled','denied_with_reason') AND (:proof_reference IS NULL OR length(trim(:proof_reference)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128) AND (:decision_reference IS NULL OR length(trim(:decision_reference)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE id=:operation_id OR operation_id=:operation_id) AND ((:expected_version=0 AND :status='received' AND :proof_reference IS NULL AND :decision_reference IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_rights_events WHERE request_id=:request_id)) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM (SELECT e.* FROM hiring_rights_events e WHERE e.request_id=:request_id ORDER BY e.version DESC LIMIT 1) old WHERE old.organization_id=:organization_id AND old.brand_id=:brand_id AND old.application_id=:application_id AND old.request_type=:request_type AND old.version=:expected_version AND ((old.status='received' AND :status IN ('identity_verification','denied_with_reason')) OR (old.status='identity_verification' AND :status IN ('processing','denied_with_reason')) OR (old.status='processing' AND :status IN ('fulfilled','denied_with_reason'))) AND (:status NOT IN ('processing','fulfilled') OR length(trim(:proof_reference)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128) AND (:status NOT IN ('fulfilled','denied_with_reason') OR length(trim(:decision_reference)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128))) AND (:status<>'fulfilled' OR :request_type IN ('access','export'))

tools.name: list_candidate_rights_events
tools.description: Owner-only bounded rights history for an exact application; missing and unauthorized both return no rows. Page by exclusive before_at/before_id.
tools.sql: SELECT e.* FROM hiring_rights_events e WHERE e.organization_id=:organization_id AND e.brand_id=:brand_id AND e.application_id=:application_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role='owner' AND p.requisition_id IS NULL) AND (:rights_request_id IS NULL OR e.request_id=:rights_request_id) AND (:before_at IS NULL OR e.created_at<:before_at OR (e.created_at=:before_at AND e.id<:before_id)) ORDER BY e.created_at DESC,e.id DESC LIMIT 50

tools.name: authorize_gateway_list_applications
tools.description: Persist a content-free, server-derived access outcome before the corresponding audited read. Missing and denied share not_found. Receipt expires after 60 seconds.
tools.sql: INSERT INTO hiring_privacy_access(id,organization_id,brand_id,actor_user_id,action,target_id,outcome,created_at,expires_at) SELECT :request_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:__user_id,'gateway_list_applications','',CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM (SELECT a.id,a.requisition_id,COALESCE(a.accepted_stage,a.stage_extension,a.stage) AS stage,a.version,CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_intake_receipts ir WHERE ir.application_id=a.id AND ir.organization_id=a.organization_id AND ir.brand_id=a.brand_id) THEN 'direct' ELSE COALESCE((SELECT s.source FROM hiring_application_sources s WHERE s.application_id=a.id),a.source) END AS source,a.assignee_user_id,a.created_at,a.updated_at,c.name AS candidate_name,(c.email IS NOT
